name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ActivationPreflight
meaning: The last activation is validated

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.AuthorizationBinding
meaning: Binds the domain, epoch, and 900-second deadline from IC time; signing requires the u64 range and at least 300 seconds remaining

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.AutomaticRetryLimit
meaning: Allowed only for the automatic lane with failures<limit

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.CanonicalProbe
meaning: The predicate is equivalent to equality of the numbers

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.CommittedQuote
meaning: The net amount is positive, gross=net+fee, and the terminal recipient and net amount match the initially stored quote

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ConfirmedActivationEvidenceBinding
meaning: A single activation match with exact metadata equality, and a Root upgrade completion hook after adoption and handoff

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.CyclesTopUpRequestPolicy
meaning: A request is allowed only when authorized, not in progress, and balance≤threshold

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.DepositAdmission
meaning: The fee, positive net amount, per-deposit limit, and window limit are satisfied

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.DepositBacking
meaning: Preserves backing and applies the prescribed accounting deltas for each operation

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.DepositIdentityPreflight
meaning: The candidate ID has not been processed

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.EpochInvalidation
meaning: Rejects authorization reissuance and rejects the old signer even in future epochs

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ExactMintFinalization
meaning: The successful receipt is at or below finalized, and deposit, recipient, and digest match the authorization

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ExpiryRefund
meaning: Unprocessed, matching deposit/digest, strictly past the deadline; preserves accounting backing

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.FeeAccountingOnce
meaning: At most one fee credit; the fee delta at signing equals the authorization value

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.FeePayout
meaning: Pending and new debits fit within the reserve; debit is accounted for only on success

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.FeeRecipientRotation
meaning: Pending payout is zero; updates the recipient while preserving balances and previously accounted fees

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.FundingAttemptLifecycle
meaning: Classifies success, duplicate, ambiguous, retryable, and definitive failure into their prescribed decisions

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.FundingReconciliationFreshness
meaning: Distinguishes conditions requiring a fresh scan from conditions permitting release

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.GovernanceConfirmationAuthorization
meaning: Accepts only a nonzero caller matching one of the three authorized principals

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.GovernanceNonceChainBinding
meaning: The governance chain matches the configured chain

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.GovernanceTransactionAffordability
meaning: The conservative balance decision reports the minimum and accepts exactly when both observed balances cover requiredWei

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.HoldResolution
meaning: Exact success or complete absence exists

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.InitialActivationAuthorization
meaning: Specifies bootstrap authorization and consumption, seal caller conditions, and migration classification

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.LeaseLaneIsolation
meaning: The target is inactive and below lane capacity

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.LeaseOutcome
meaning: The lease is active with a matching generation; preserves accounting invariants and other records

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.LedgerBlockProvenance
meaning: Preserves existing indices, rejects conflicts, and requires a funding index for refunds

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.NonterminalDepositIndexConsistency
meaning: Only phases other than refunded, cancelled, and minted are indexed

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.NotificationQuotaIsolation
meaning: Below global, caller, and ingestion limits; cooldown requires matching hashes and time before expiry

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.OperationalConfigSeal
meaning: Seals only when not already sealed and the candidate is valid; allows asset operations only when sealed

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.PaidCallCycleReserve
meaning: Preserves the reserve after charging

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.PaymentIdentity
meaning: The payout net amount and recipient match the record; records with other IDs remain unchanged

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.PendingQueue
meaning: Preserves blocked retries; on write failure, retains the session with no durable result

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.RefundEvidenceEnforcement
meaning: Requires unprocessed status, matching deposit/digest, and strict expiry

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.RefundRequestAuthorization
meaning: Requires authenticated=true and depositProcessed=false

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ReservationCommit
meaning: Preserves the reservation-plus-candidate total, releases to exactly zero, and rejects double release

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ReservationLifecycle
meaning: Sets the reservation to exactly zero and rejects double release

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.RuntimeAttestationReuse
meaning: The reuse domain matches the current install domain

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ServiceFeeMaximum
meaning: Fee changes stay within fixed bounds; signing fees are accounted for once

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.SettlementBacking
meaning: Preserves backing and applies prescribed deltas to escrow, feeReserve, and outstanding liabilities

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.SigningCycleReserve
meaning: Preserves the reserve after billing

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.WithdrawalAdmissionBoundary
meaning: The minimum is nonzero and observed is at least the minimum

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.WithdrawalFinalityQuorum
meaning: Two providers attest the height; the identity variant requires agreement on both height and hash

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.WithdrawalFinalization
meaning: Notify requires success, a block at or below finalized, and canonicality; missing finalized yields retry

name: BridgeSpec.GlobalHistory.AccountingInvariant
meaning: Constrains only ID uniqueness, aggregate agreement, backing, and the record types holding reservations

name: BridgeSpec.GlobalHistory.Backed
meaning: escrow=baseSupply+feeReserve+unmintedLiability+unreleasedLiability

name: BridgeSpec.GlobalHistory.eventDelta
meaning: Selection of accounting events. Callback phases do not authenticate actual Ledger transfers

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.AdmissibleUntilOccurs
meaning: Assumes the target terminal event remains admissible until selected

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.CommonOperationalAssumptions
meaning: Combines continuous availability from readyAt onward with weak fairness

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.DepositTerminalProgressLemmas
meaning: Conjunction of conditional mint and refund implications, not an either/or guarantee for one shared execution

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.ExpiredDepositEventuallyRefunded
meaning: The target deposit reaches refunded

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.FundedDepositEventuallyMinted
meaning: The target deposit reaches minted

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.FundingFailureEventuallyCancelled
meaning: The target deposit reaches cancelled

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.WeakFair
meaning: Assumes a continuously enabled concrete event is eventually selected

name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.WithdrawalEventuallyPaid
meaning: The target withdrawal reaches paid

name: BridgeSpec.MintAuthorization.Authorization.valid
meaning: Matching authorization domain, epoch, amount, and IC-origin deadline. Cryptographic digest computation is excluded

name: BridgeSpec.MintAuthorization.ExpiryEvidence.valid
meaning: Matches decoded unprocessed evidence and strict expiry

name: BridgeSpec.MintAuthorization.MintEvidence.valid
meaning: Matches decoded mint evidence fields. Authenticity of nonzero hashes is an external premise

name: BridgeSpec.MintAuthorization.installSignature
meaning: Abstract transition checking 300 seconds remaining at signing, finite-width bounds, and fee accounting once

name: BridgeSpec.Protocol.Safe
meaning: Accounting, quote, and lease conditions of the integrated single-record model, not overall runtime safety

name: BridgeSpec.Protocol.filterSafeStoredState
meaning: Abstract filter accepting states under the Safe condition, not production decoding or migration

name: BridgeSpec.signatureTimeAllowed
meaning: Predicate for a u64 deadline, rejection of addition overflow, and at least 300 seconds remaining

name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.governanceAffordabilityDecision
meaning: Returns the smaller observed balance and the inclusive affordability comparison
